modalLead: Trying on a theme no longer means committing to it: move through the theme list and the dashboard changes with you. There are also 23 new themes to move through.

items.text: See a theme before you pick it. Open the Theme list under Appearance and move up and down it — the dashboard behind takes on each theme as you go. Nothing is saved until you choose one.
Change your mind freely. Press Esc or click away and the theme you started with comes straight back, so browsing the list can never leave you somewhere you did not want.

23 new themes. Among them Blueprint, white rule on process blue; Static Noise, grey from end to end with no colour anywhere; Signal Flare, everything muted but one hot magenta; and Bone China, warm porcelain with a cool blue hairline. Each comes in a light and a dark version.
